title: We're building an agentic workspace for Unreal Engine, and we're giving free early access to users for feedback
author: creatormaximalist
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I'm part of the team at Bezi, where we're building an AI agent that works inside your game engine. I've posted our Unity updates here a few times before, and today I wanted to share that we've brought it to Unreal Engine. Our[ ](https://www.bezi.com/unreal)[early access is now live](https://www.bezi.com/unreal), and we're looking for feedback to help improve our product.

Bezi can now:

* Author and edit Blueprints, new or existing (placing nodes, setting variables, wiring execution and data pins)
* Build and edit materials (texture samples, parameters, material outputs)
* Assemble PCG graphs from rules you give it
* Start Play In Editor, drive the inputs, and play through the session
* And the everyday stuff (C++ and .ini files, levels, Game Mode and Pawn setup, Niagara, etc.)

https://reddit.com/link/1wu8yi2/video/hze7xyfhkosh1/player

It's early, and you may run into a couple of bugs. That's why it's free to use, since we'd love for you to push it to its limits and tell us how we can improve. Native Perforce integration and animation are up next.

A few things to know:

* It needs Unreal Engine 5.4 or above.
* Bezi can edit your project files directly, so its changes show up in source control like your own, and you revert them the same way.
* Registering for the early access puts you on the waitlist, where we are seating users in batches.

If you work in Unreal, especially if you spend your days in Blueprints, materials, or PCG, you can register for the early access here: [https://www.bezi.com/unreal](https://www.bezi.com/unreal)

We're also taking questions and feedback in our [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/bezi).

As always, happy to answer anything in the comments or over DM. Any and all feedback is appreciated!
